summary.text: Aaron Saunders is a Democratic state representative who has represented the Massachusetts House of Representatives 7th Hampden District since January 4, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He earned a B.A. in political science from the University of Massachusetts Amherst in 2002 and worked in government relations and as a chief of staff to a state senator.

paragraphs.text: Aaron Saunders earned a B.A. in political science from the University of Massachusetts at Amherst in 2002.

His career experience includes co-founding Loophole Brewing Services and working as senior vice president of Benchmark Strategies, senior manager of government and community relations at Comcast, and chief of staff to State Senator Gale Candaras.
Ballotpedia notes his affiliation with the Ludlow Boys Club & Girls Club Corporation.
He succeeded Jacob Oliveira in the 7th Hampden District seat; for 2025-2026 he is listed as vice chair of the Joint Committee on Agriculture and Fisheries.
